text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the Spring Fan Fest, a day when Umamusume can repay their fans for all the support. Yukino Bijin is beyond excited.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Why, lookit all these people who've come t'see us!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There might still be some who don't care 'bout my races…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But this's my chance t'show 'em my skills 'n' turn them 'round!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's Yukino Bijin! Isn't she the one everyone was talking about last year?

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan B
text_block_list.text: Aw, she's so cute! Wow, I feel so lucky getting to see her right off the bat! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: U-um! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be participat'n in the True Or False Quiz, so be sure t'come and check it out!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fans A and B
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, okay! We'll be there! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan A
text_block_list.text: I wonder when it starts? Maybe we should take a look.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey! Ev'ry journey starts with the first step!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And for this journey, I'm start'n from scratch.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The folks who liked me when I first made a buzz prob'ly don't feel the same way 'bout me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Not that I'm complain'n or anyth'n! That's the way the trendy cookie crumbles.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But it makes me wanna put on a killer show so people won't ever lose int'rest again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's true that some people who jumped on the bandwagon won't stay aboard for long…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, it's almost time for the main event, so I've gotta—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yukino! We came to cheer you on! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's you two!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait, did you come all the way here just t'cheer for me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans A and B
text_block_list.text: We sure did!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Things have been hectic, so we haven't been able to come and cheer for you for a while, but you're still the number one cutest in our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's not just that you're cute, though… I just can't forget the way you look while pushing yourself! The way you run is unforgettable.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: We're going to be there for you at the Victoria Mile too! So don't worry 'cause you got this, Yukino! We believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles! That sure means a lot t'me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some of her current fans certainly may have started as mere trend-chasers…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But without a doubt, there are also fans who genuinely fell in love with her running, and that number is only going to grow.
choice_data_list: Go and show your fans what you're made of!
Go and show your fans what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Righto!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And now, the event you've been waiting for—the True Or False Quiz! Our contestants have to answer a series of true or false questions. Wrong answers will result in a mud bath!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Our next contestant is Yukino Bijin! I hope you're ready!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm ready for anyth'n and everyth'n! Fire away!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Fantastic! Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Question one! True or false? The difference between a cafe au lait and a cafe latte lies in the type of milk used.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! That's one tough cookie of a question!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Both of 'em have milk. I know that much…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gosh, I 'member Cafe tell'n me about this ages ago…

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Well then, Yukino Bijin! It's time for you to give us your answer! What's your verdict? Is the question true or false?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All righty, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw geez… Did I get't wrong?

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so sorry! The correct answer is "false"! The difference has nothing to do with the milk used. It's whether the beverage uses drip coffee or espresso.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, now I remember! I'm such a goober!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, win some, lose some! Least I know better for next time!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin is such a good kid! She's still so positive even after getting covered in all that mud.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: You did great, Yukino! Better luck next time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Looks like I better study up on all the snazzy city drinks and trends!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! I did it! I got it right!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! "False" is the correct answer! The difference has nothing to do with the milk used. It's whether the beverage uses drip coffee or espresso.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowie! I can't believe I nailed a question 'bout fancy city drinks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't've done it without my roomie Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: At this rate, it won't be long b'fore I start giv'n out some big city vibes myself. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Yukino Bijin! That was some beautiful running just now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks bunches!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do my best in my races too, so make sure you come t'cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: We will! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin manages to leave a strong impression on the spectators.
